summary: Kerb beside the rail corridor, with cars parked along it in Esri.
reasons: Backs onto rail corridor, no homes
Six cars parked along kerb in Esri
Houses 23 m+ away across the road

best_section.where: Pike Avenue north kerb, along the railway fence near the junction

drivers.seclusion: Rail embankment and scrub on the section's side; nearest dwellings 23-27 m away across the road. A house sits 9 m from the far end, outside the section.
drivers.access_and_room: Road wide at the junction; Esri shows six vehicles parked nose to tail along this kerb.
drivers.traffic: Local junction with some through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars parked here in Esri (2025), none in QLD (2022); it looks like an established spot.

flags: Signs: Ada Street 1/4P and No Stopping Any Time within 12-15 m, check which kerb they cover
Junction nearby, keep clear of the corner
sun_shade: Open to sun all day; scrub and rail trees add little shade.
cannot_judge: Which kerb the Ada Street signs apply to
